# sharepoint_theme (Resource)

Registers a custom SharePoint Online theme at the tenant level using the M365 CLI (m365 spo theme set / get / remove). Use sharepoint_theme_apply to apply a registered theme to a site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The JSON must contain the complete Fluent UI palette
# (themePrimary, themeLighterAlt, ..., neutralDark, black, white).
resource "sharepoint_theme" "contoso_blue" {
  name  = "Contoso Blue"
  theme = file("${path.module}/contoso-blue.json")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the theme.
- `theme` (String) JSON object with the theme's color palette. Must contain exactly the properties of the Fluent UI theme palette (themePrimary, themeLighterAlt, ..., neutralDark, black, white), each a hex color.

### Optional

- `is_inverted` (Boolean) Whether the theme is an inverted (dark) theme.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as name; themes are identified by name, not a separate ID.
- `theme_hash` (String) SHA-256 hash of the theme's canonicalized JSON content, for use as a change trigger elsewhere (e.g. sharepoint_theme_apply's content_version).
